summary: Production-quality workflow and library. Best practices: pinned action refs (v4), minimal permissions, idempotent Pester setup, proper error handling, approved cmdlet verbs. Cleanly factored functions with no duplication; each has clear purpose. Dense regex patterns in ConvertFrom-ConventionalCommit and Update-Changelog logic are documented but could use inline breakdowns. File format assumptions (JSON version on single line, CHANGELOG header structure) underdocumented. Two-stage pipeline (needs: test) sound; comprehensive function docs and error handling throughout.
